correctness.rationale: The algebraic per-capita cancellation is exact; compact cube faces point inward by strict rational inequalities; logarithmic Jacobian satisfies row measure <= -9/2 uniformly for every dimension and arbitrary real fixed r,B. The sup-norm differential inequality proves unique globally attracting equilibrium within Q with explicit exponential rate. A one-dimensional fixed r=b=-1 instance rigorously rules out universal quadratic-per-capita-only stabilization. Finite checker supports arithmetic, not the infinite proof. Strict hypotheses and boundaries are stated.

value.rationale: A natural gap in the source is the minimal interaction support required to restore coexistence without altering prescribed pairwise structure. A constructive sparse self-only completion reduces the HOI support to 2n parameters, supplies a uniform positive cube and exponential bound independent of dimension and pairwise magnitude (with appropriate gain scaling), and proves maximum order four necessary for all coefficients. These are structural, biologically interpretable sparsity/robustness conclusions rather than a parameter tweak or rederivation of the source existence theorem.
